services.name: OKGN Boat Rentals
services.desc: Your lake day should feel easy, but safety comes first. This page explains the main safety and rental requirements for OKGN Boat Rentals captained charters on Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, BC. Final approval always happens at the dock and may depend on weather, lake conditions, and guest count. Every OKGN rental includes a commercially licensed, Transport Canada SVOP-certified (Small Vessel Operator Proficiency), OKGN-approved captain who runs the boat, so guests never need a Pleasure Craft Operator Card to ride as passengers. The captain has final authority over route, watersports, speed, docking, weather calls, and whether a trip should be delayed, shortened, rescheduled, or cancelled for
